observations: wire_size accepts str or bytes and returns len of UTF-8 encoded bytes for str, or len of the bytes object directly.
For str input, encoding uses UTF-8, so multi-byte characters count as their encoded byte length.
For bytes input, the value is returned unchanged without re-encoding, matching the stated contract.
Empty str encodes to b'' and returns 0.
No type validation: non-str, non-bytes inputs (e.g., int, None) would raise TypeError from len() or encode().
The changed line is the sole return statement; behavior depends entirely on the isinstance branch.
